_note: Enemy types of the waves. IDs are stable (lower snake_case). form: forms.json ID (the enemy is an ordinary character of that form, same rules as players). imprint: element whose imprint it has (elements.json; empty = none) - with fire its bolt carries fire. Numbers (level, nXP, reaction time, error rate, ...) live in values.json, section enemies; which enemies come in which wave: values.json, section waves.
